title: WPMS/3182/2015 of Mahendra Singh Vs Karam Singh AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No.3182 of 2015
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Devang Dobhal, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Late Mr. Karan Singh had instituted Original
Suit No.2 of 2007, Karam Singh vs. Mahendra
Singh, wherein, he has sought a decree with regards
to the property in question and the nature of relief
which has been sought for is to the following effect:-
 "(a) A decree for rectification of the sale deeds
dated 18.03.2005 shown to have been executed in
favour of the defendants may very kindly be passed
in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendants
rectifying the sale deeds to the extend that the total
land sold by these sale deeds is only 770 square
meters and/or the sale deed dated 18.03.2005 which
is registered in the office of Sub-Registrar Rishikesh
District Dehradun at book no.1, volume 2 page 50,
additional book no.1, volume 356 at page
no.139/148 at serial no.869 on 18.03.2005 be
rectified to the effect that only 330 square meters of
land was sold by the plaintiff vide this sale deed and
the boundaries of both these sale deeds be rectified
as shown in the plan attached and its intimation be
also sent to the Sub Registrar, Rishikesh.
(b) A decree for cancellation of the saqle deed dated
12.07.2005 which is registered in the office of Sub
Registrar, Rishikesh, District Dehradun in book
no.1, volume 2 page 56, additional book no.1,
volume 386 at page no.93/102 at serial no.2373 on
12.07.2005 may very kindly be pleased in favour of
the plaintiff and against the defendant nos.1 and 4.
(c) A decree for permanent injunction may very
kindly be passed in favour of the plaintiff and
against the defendants restraining the defendants
their servants agents etc from in any way creating
third party interest over the remaining property of
the plaintiff forming part of Khasra no.1328 Ka area
.0730 hectare, Mauza Rani Pokhri Grant, Pargana
Parwa Doon, District Dehradun and which is shown

by black slanting lines in the plan attached and is
described in schedule given at the end of this plaint.
(d) Full cost of the suit be awarded in favour of the
plaintiff and against the defendants.
(e) Any further and other reliefs to which the
plaintiff is found to be entitled under the facts and
circumstances of the case may also very kindly be
awarded in favour of the plaintiff and against the
defendants."
In relation to the following property as
described at the foot of the plaint which is held as
under:-
SCHEDULE OF PROPERTY
"Land bearing Khasra no.1328 Ka area
.0730 hectare, Mauza Rani Pokhri Grant, Pargana
Parwa Doon, District Dehradun and which is shown
by black slanting lines in the plan attaches."
During the pendency of the proceedings
before this Court in relation to the property in
question, the respondent no.1/plaintiff Karam Singh
had met with the sad demise. Subsequently, his
heirs have been substituted in the present writ
petition.
A statement has been made by the counsel for
the petitioner, that the plaintiff/respondents have
now withdrawn their suit, no lis as such survives
now to be decided out of which the present writ
petition was arising.
In view of the withdrawal of the suit by the
plaintiff/respondent, the present writ petition has
been rendered infructuous and the same is
accordingly dismissed, as having rendered
infructuous.
However, there would no order as to costs.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 24.06.2019
Ravi
